remarks: Spacious 2 bedroom 2 full bath (1260sf) downtown Stamford in a mid-rise building with elevator. Primary bedroom has a private bath with tub and a separate stall shower. Engineered wood floor throughout. Large living/dining room with sliders to balcony. Full kitchen with peninsula. Good size laundry room with washer and dryer. One assigned parking space included in rent. Second car parking space available on first come basis. Well maintained complex with a community room and an outdoor seasonal in-ground swimming pool. Tenant pays electricity, cable, move-in/out, renters insurance and credit/background check for each applicant. Owner requires excellent credit score, employment verification, proof of income. All documents to submit to the owner for approval.
